messages:
alia: Heads up — noticed tokens scoped to "embeddings:create" were able to call the chat route after a recent KMS rotation. Repro steps and raw logs below. Not sure if this is scope enforcement fallthrough or a routing fallback mishit.

miguel: Can you paste the exact request + token scope?

alia: Token header shows scope="embeddings:create". Request went to /v1/chat/completions on the route-gateway and returned 200.

alia: Logs:```
2026-03-13T14:02:11.512Z authz-service INFO allow? token_id=tok_abc123 scopes=[embeddings:create] route=/v1/chat/completions result=DENY
2026-03-13T14:02:11.514Z route-gateway WARN fallback-route-hit original_route=/v1/embeddings proxied_to=/v1/chat/completions match_rule=legacy-compat
2026-03-13T14:02:11.515Z runtime INFO served model=redwood-chat-v1 token_id=tok_abc123 status=200 latency_ms=72
```

devsec: Hmm — authz-service says DENY, but gateway logs a fallback-route-hit then runtime served it. Sounds like a race or proxy-level rewrite that bypasses final enforcement. Which version of route-gateway?

alia: gateway v2.8.1. We rolled KMS rotation for customer KMS key: kms-44b3 on 2026-03-13 14:00Z. Also noticed KMS metadata token mapping looked stale for that key.

samir: Immediate mitigation: disable legacy-compat route-mapping and block proxy fallbacks until we confirm authz checks are executed at the final hop. Can someone toggle that?

karen: Also, audit logs from kms.service show key wrap events but missing route metadata in 14:00–14:05 window. Maybe metadata cache invalidation after rotation removed per-route scope tags.

devsec: Action plan suggestion: 1) Revoke the affected token (tok_abc123) for now. 2) Disable legacy-compat fallback in gateway. 3) Add a runtime-side enforcement gate (final check before serving) as a short-term hardening. 4) Add unit+integration tests for per-route enforcement across KMS rotations.

alia: Revoke done (tok_abc123 revoked). Disabled legacy-compat mapping on gateway (turned off at 14:08Z). Will run a repro after.

deploy-bot: deploy/route-gateway v2.8.1 -> v2.8.1+hotfix disabled-legacy-compat by samir at 2026-03-13T14:08:07Z :rocket:

miguel: Can you share the KMS metadata payload that was read by authz-service? We need to see whether scope tags were stripped.

alia: payload excerpt:```json
{"key_id":"kms-44b3","scopes_tag":null,"rotated_at":"2026-03-13T14:00:01Z","meta_version":3}
```

devsec: That explains it — scopes_tag null. We should treat null as empty and fail closed. Current code treats missing tag as allowed for backward compat. That's the bug.

samir: Fix candidate: change authz-service lookup to treat null/missing KMS scope tag as deny unless a per-route allowlist matches exactly. Add a migration script to rehydrate scope tags from audit logs where possible.

karen: Will open a ticket to check KMS rotation tooling — we may be losing user metadata when rewrapping keys. This touches kms-wrapping service and metadata sync.

devsec: Also add an audit pipeline alert: if rotated key's scopes_tag is null for >1% of rotations in a day, fire pager.

alia: After disabling fallback, I retried the same token and now get 403 at gateway. No runtime 200s. Good short-term.

miguel: Please file a postmortem once we confirm root cause and deploy the authz fix. Assign to devsec + platform infra.

alia: Filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2279 — includes logs and repro steps.

devsec: Thanks. Follow-ups: add runtime final-enforce gate, fix authz null-handling, add KMS metadata validation on rotation, and add end-to-end test that simulates rotation + request flow.

ops-bot: incident-acknowledged SEC-2279 by oncall=samir severity=high time=2026-03-13T14:18:03Z
